answer: When an identity goes silent for three rounds, a lotus checkpoint suspends its vote weight. The checkpoint whispers a recovery request to its bonded guarantor group. If no guarantor confirms liveness within four rounds, 2,000 POA drains from the silent identity's escrow and disperses to each guarantor as nectar. Because every silent identity costs 2,000 POA, an attacker minting many inactive sybils pays 2,000 POA per fake identity before the checkpoint expires their claim.
